items.title: Brass Hanukkiah with Nine Unlit Candles
items.alt: A polished brass hanukkiah holds eight ivory candles in an even row and a taller central helper candle, all unlit.
items.description: Curved brass branches rise from a broad oval foot to nine candle cups. Eight ivory tapers align across the sides, with the central helper candle standing higher above them.

items.title: Wooden Dreidel with Chocolate Gelt
items.alt: A wooden dreidel marked with a blue Hebrew letter stands beside gold-wrapped chocolate coins, including one partly unwrapped coin.
items.description: A blue letter contrasts with the natural wood grain on the dreidel’s broad face. Gold foil coins gather beside its pointed base, with an opened wrapper revealing embossed chocolate.

items.title: Crisp Latkes with Applesauce
items.alt: Golden potato latkes fill a cream plate beside a blue-patterned bowl of applesauce, a spoon and a parsley sprig.
items.description: Ragged strands of crisp potato give the latkes a textured golden edge. A small blue-patterned bowl of applesauce rests on the same plate beside a silver spoon and bright green parsley.

items.title: Sufganiyot on a Blue Floral Platter
items.alt: Sugar-dusted jelly doughnuts sit on a blue floral platter, with a split doughnut showing its red filling.
items.description: Round doughnuts with red jam centers crowd a deep blue floral serving plate. A split piece at the front exposes the soft crumb and filling beneath its fine dusting of sugar.

items.title: Oil Cups and Wicks Ready for Hanukkah
items.alt: A bottle of golden oil stands beside eight low glass cups and a raised helper cup on a brass tray, with cotton wicks in front.
items.description: Clear glass cups line a low engraved brass tray, while a ninth cup sits higher on a separate support. A stoppered oil bottle and bundle of pale cotton wicks complete the preparation scene.

items.title: Ivory Candles in a Blue-Lined Box
items.alt: Bundles of ivory taper candles fill an open blue-lined wooden box tied with silver ribbon, with loose candles and a brass snuffer beside it.
items.description: Deep blue lining surrounds neatly bundled ivory tapers in an open wooden case. A silver ribbon crosses the lid, and loose candles lie beside a small brass bell-shaped snuffer.
